summary: After an angry meeting, police add unmarked cars and ask residents to buy alarms and cameras.
realLife: Following a packed public meeting on a burglary wave, a department put plainclothes officers in unmarked cars on patrol and urged residents to add cameras and alarms linked to police. The story reported no budget change and no charges in the main series.
sources: The Almanac (Atherton, California), 'Atherton police: At least $2M in jewelry, other items stolen this year', Feb 5, 2019: https://www.almanacnews.com/news/print/2019/02/05/atherton-police-at-least-2m-in-jewelry-other-items-stolen-this-year
